title: Senior full stack developer
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.
Job Duties:
You’ll own the delivery lifecycle end-to-end — from architecture and design to production reliability, technical mentorship, and stakeholder alignment. We’re looking for someone who can turn complex requirements into secure, scalable, high-quality software — and help the team grow in the process.
Key Responsibilities: Own architecture and design: create system diagrams, define functional and non-functional requirements (such as scalability, reliability, security and cost), and set integration standards. Build and deliver using our technology stack (see below) with focus on quality, performance, and observability. Lead initiatives: break down roadmaps, manage small to medium-sized projects, remove blockers, and ensure on-time delivery. Plan and prioritize: create execution plans, estimate effort, manage risks, and clearly communicate progress to stakeholders. Drive engineering excellence: enforce automated testing (unit, integration, e2e), deep code reviews, branch and release standards, and code quality. Document for scale: maintain architecture documents, ADRs, operational guides, and runbooks, ensuring traceability and clarity within agile processes and tools. Client interaction: attend remote and in-person meetings, capture requirements, discuss trade-offs, and present solutions clearly. Mentor others: guide mid-level and junior developers, share best practices, lead tech talks, and promote a learning culture. Partner management: coordinate third parties, validate deliverables, and ensure alignment with project goals. Ensure production quality: validate system integrations, instrument logs, metrics, and tracing, define basic SLOs, and participate in post-mortems. Continuous learning: explore new technologies, identify process improvements, and propose architectural enhancements.
Administrative support: handle operational requests and be available for national or international travel when required.
Qualifications: Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or related field. Experience: 7+ years of professional experience, including technical leadership on complex projects. Stack: Backend (Java, Python and. Net Core), Frontend (Angular), Node.js, SQL, strong background in REST API development, microservices and event-driven architectures. Cloud: Hands-on experience with AWS or Azure, IAM (Identity and Access Management), storage, managed services and observability. Quality & Dev Ops: Test automation, Git, Gitflow, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, semantic versioning and promotion across environments. Security & Reliability: Familiarity with OWASP Top 10, secret management, least privilege, basic hardening, and observability (logs, metrics, tracing). Language: Advanced English (written and spoken, client-facing).
Profile: Proactive, system thinker, fluent with modern frameworks and best practices in development, testing, and cloud operations.
Nice to have:
Postgraduate or Master’s degree.
Spanish proficiency.
Ia C (Terraform) and platform engineering principles.
Multi-cloud experience (AWS/Azure/GCP) and cost/performance optimization.
Exposure to performance tuning, caching, messaging/queue systems (e.g., Kafka), and feature flag management.
Halliburton is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation .

title: Analista de planejamento e controle regulatório pleno
description:
O movimento da vida gera resultados e também resíduos.
Isso faz parte do ciclo natural de uma cidade viva e em constante transformação. Mas acreditamos que esses resíduos podem ter um destino melhor e possível continuando a gerar valor e mantendo a vida em movimento.
Foi com esse propósito que nasceu a Regenera Rio .
Uma empresa dedicada a transformar a forma como o Rio de Janeiro lida com seus resíduos, provenientes de residências, comércios e indústrias, garantindo um destino ambientalmente adequado. Tudo pensado para que o ciclo do saneamento básico seja completo: do transporte ao tratamento.
Um movimento que impulsiona a economia local, apoia a geração de empregos diretos e indiretos, fortalece a cadeia da reciclagem e contribui para uma cidade mais limpa e sustentável.
Essa transformação reduz os impactos ambientais causados pela destinação incorreta dos resíduos, promove melhorias diretas na saúde e na qualidade de vida da população carioca e impulsiona a economia circular, conectando pessoas, negócios e meio ambiente.
Principais Responsabilidades
Consolidar e analisar indicadores contratuais e regulatórios.
Construir, atualizar e acompanhar modelos de fluxo de caixa e demonstrativos de resultado.
Avaliar impactos de eventos contratuais como reequilíbrios, pleitos, investimentos antecipados ou postergações.
Atuar de forma integrada com as áreas Jurídica, Regulatório, Planejamento Interno e stakeholders externos.
Apoiar análises de teses jurídicas sob a ótica econômico-financeira.
Garantir a manutenção do equilíbrio econômico-financeiro dos contratos.
Requisitos
Formação superior em Engenharia, Economia, Administração, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas.
Experiência em planejamento financeiro, concessões, PPPs ou contratos de longo prazo.
Domínio de modelagem econômico-financeira, fluxo de caixa e DRE.
Vivência em ambientes regulados será um diferencial.
Benefícios:
Assistência médica;
Assistência odontológica;
Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
Seguro de vida;

Gympass;
Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
Kit office.
Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!
Atuamos na Região Metropolitana do Rio de Janeiro.
Estamos presentes de forma estruturada e integrada na cidade do Rio de Janeiro e Região Metropolitana, com unidades operacionais localizadas em pontos estratégicos para o recebimento, transferência, tratamento e destinação ambientalmente adequada dos resíduos coletados.
Nosso compromisso é transformar a forma como os resíduos são geridos, criando valor ambiental, social e econômico a partir do que antes era descartado. Onde outros veem fim, nós enxergamos recomeço: onde tudo tenha a chance de se regenerar.

You are a Senior Data Engineer who enjoys building reliable, scalable data platforms and enabling data-driven and AI-powered products. title: International buyer
description:
General Description
The Buyer will be responsible for sourcing, purchasing, and assisting in the management of the inventory for the landing gear MRO operations. This role will require a high level of attention to detail, an understanding of the aerospace industry, and the ability to work effectively with vendors, suppliers, and internal teams to ensure timely delivery of materials, components, and parts for maintenance and repair services.
Detailed Description
Procurement of Materials & Parts:
Source and purchase materials, components, and parts required for landing gear MRO operations.
Evaluate and select suppliers based on quality, cost, lead times, and reliability.
Ensure all purchases meet the required specifications and are compliant with industry standards and regulations (e.g., FAA, EASA).
Inventory Management:
Assist in the maintenance of optimal inventory levels with warehouse team to support continuous MRO operations while minimizing excess stock and potential obsolescence.
Help warehouse team if necessary, in the tracking and monitoring of the stock usage, reordering materials and components as necessary.
Supplier Relationship Management:
Develop and maintain strong relationships with key suppliers and vendors to ensure high-quality products and timely deliveries.
Negotiate pricing, terms, and conditions with suppliers to ensure competitive sourcing and cost savings.
Quality Assurance & Compliance:
Work closely with the quality control and engineering teams to ensure that all materials and parts purchased meet the required standards for safety and performance.
Monitor and address any quality issues, returns, or discrepancies with suppliers.
Data Entry & Reporting:
Maintain accurate records of all purchasing transactions, including purchase orders, invoices, and delivery schedules.
Prepare regular procurement reports to track spending, inventory levels, and supplier performance.
Collaboration & Cross-functional Support:
Collaborate with maintenance, engineering, and other departments to identify material needs and ensure procurement aligns with operational requirements.
Provide support to project teams by ensuring the timely availability of materials for scheduled landing gear maintenance projects.
Cost Control:
Monitor and control procurement costs to meet budget targets and contribute to cost-saving initiatives.
Identify opportunities for process improvements and cost efficiencies in procurement activities.
Qualification Minimum Requirements
Work Experience:
At least 3-5 years of experience in procurement or purchasing, ideally in an aerospace, MRO, or manufacturing environment.
Knowledge of landing gear systems, aerospace components, and regulatory requirements (FAA, EASA) is a significant advantage
Educational:
Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Business, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field preferred.
Fluent/advanced English
Technical Skills:
Proficient in procurement software and Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, etc.).
Knowledge of inventory management systems and ERP tools is a plus. (Oracle and quantum)
Soft Skills:
Strong negotiation and communication skills.
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Análise e solução: Atuar na análise inicial de problemas e novas implementações, propondo soluções e depurando sistemas em cenários complexos.
Gestão de crise (Hands-on pontual): Liderar a resolução de problemas críticos em produção, atuando tecnicamente quando necessário.
Gestão de esteira: Supervisionar e entender o processo de build e deploy , gestão de branchs e a administração da esteira de CI/CD (incluindo ambientes em Open Shift ).
Requisitos essenciais (Obrigatórios):
Experiência consolidada (mínimo 5 anos ) em desenvolvimento, arquitetura ou liderança técnica.
Profundo conhecimento e experiência prática em C#. NET (Core e Framework) e Angular.
Sólidos conhecimentos em Modelagem de Banco de Dados (preferencialmente SQL Server) e linguagem SQL.
Experiência em metodologias ágeis e tradicionais de desenvolvimento.
Vivência anterior atuando como interface direta com usuários ou áreas de negócio (levantamento de requisitos, definição de escopo).
Inglês Intermediário para leitura e escrita de documentação técnica.
Diferenciais (Desejáveis):
Conhecimento em Mensageria (principalmente Kafka ).
Vivência com ambientes de containers (preferencialmente Open Shift, Docker ou Kubernetes ).
Conhecimento em Arquitetura de TI e Integração de Sistemas.
Pós-graduação na área de Tecnologia.

title: Business development specialist
description:
We are seeking an ambitious and results-driven Business Development Manager specialized in engineering services to join our team in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. This role is essential for expanding our footprint in the engineering sector, driving new client acquisition, and strengthening strategic partnerships across Brazil’s key industries such as oil & gas, infrastructure, energy, manufacturing, and construction.
You will focus on selling a range of engineering solutions including design, consulting, project management, EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction), technical staffing, and specialized engineering services. If you have a strong network in Brazil’s engineering ecosystem and a proven ability to win complex, high-value contracts, this is your opportunity to play a pivotal role in our growth in one of Latin America’s most dynamic markets.
Key Responsibilities
Identify and develop new business opportunities in the engineering services sector across Brazil, with a primary focus on Rio de Janeiro and surrounding regions.
Prospect and qualify leads through targeted outreach, industry events, referrals, and digital channels (Linked In, sector-specific networks).
Build and maintain long-term relationships with key decision-makers in oil & gas companies, infrastructure developers, industrial manufacturers, energy firms, and government-related entities.
Develop tailored proposals and solutions that address clients’ engineering challenges.
Lead the full sales cycle: from initial contact, needs assessment, and technical presentations to contract negotiation and deal closure.
Collaborate with engineering, delivery, and technical teams to ensure proposals are competitive and aligned with client requirements.
Track market trends, competitor activity, regulatory changes, and upcoming projects (e.g., via ANP, IBAMA, public tenders) to inform strategy.
Achieve and exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets for engineering services contracts.
Represent the company at industry events, trade shows (e.g., Rio Oil & Gas, OTC Brazil), and professional associations in Rio and São Paulo.
Qualifications and Skills
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Petroleum, or related) or Business Administration. MBA or postgraduate studies are a plus.
5+ years of experience in B2 B business development or sales within the engineering services sector (consulting, design, EPC, technical outsourcing, etc.). Proven track record of winning and closing high-value engineering contracts (ideally > R$1 M).
Strong existing network in Brazil’s engineering market, particularly in Rio de Janeiro (oil & gas, energy, infrastructure sectors highly desirable).
Fluency in Portuguese and English (Spanish is a bonus). Excellent presentation and negotiation skills.
Familiarity with public and private tender processes in Brazil
Proficiency in CRM tools
Ability to understand technical engineering requirements and translate them into commercial value propositions.
Self-starter with strong hunter mentality, capable of working independently in a target-driven environment.

title: Estilista especialista
description:
O Especialista Estilista é o mentor criativo responsável por idealizar e projetar as coleções de Athleisure, garantindo que a marca esteja na vanguarda das tendências mundiais de moda e comportamento. Sua missão é conceber o direcionamento estético e o conceito das coleções, transformando inspirações globais em produtos que equilibram perfeitamente o desejo de moda lifestyle com a funcionalidade esportiva. Ele atua como o líder criativo que define o tom da marca, assegurando inovação constante e relevância comercial.

Responsabilidades Principais:
Criação e Conceituação de Coleção: Liderar o desenvolvimento de temas, cartelas de cores e formas, criando o DNA visual das coleções de cada entrada sazonal. Pesquisa de Tendências Mundiais: Realizar pesquisas contínuas sobre o mercado de Athleisure global, antecipando movimentos de moda, novos shapes e comportamentos de consumo. Direcionamento Criativo: Propor os conceitos e ideias que servirão de base para o desenvolvimento técnico, garantindo que a essência criativa seja o ponto de partida de cada peça. Interface de Viabilidade Criativa: Trabalhar em sinergia com o Especialista de Design para garantir que a visão estética original seja traduzida fielmente em produtos técnicos viáveis. Curadoria de Materiais e Estilo: Selecionar matérias-primas e acabamentos que reforcem o posicionamento de moda tecnológica e lifestyle da marca.
Guardião do Lifestyle da Marca: Zelar pela consistência estética e pela evolução da imagem da marca, garantindo que o produto final seja uma referência de estilo no mercado.
Requisitos e Qualificações:
Experiência Profissional: Experiência consolidada como Estilista Criativo, com histórico comprovado no desenvolvimento de coleções de moda, preferencialmente no nicho Sportswear ou Athleisure. Domínio Estético e Repertório: Profundo conhecimento de história da moda, tendências contemporâneas e capacidade de traduzir conceitos abstratos em coleções comerciais. Visão de Mercado Global: Habilidade para adaptar tendências internacionais para o contexto do varejo nacional, mantendo o DNA da marca. Habilidades Criativas: Domínio de ferramentas de ilustração e desenho de moda, com olhar apurado para proporções, cores e composições.
Formação: Graduação em Moda, Design de Moda ou áreas correlatas.

Vivência em viagens de pesquisa internacional e participação em feiras globais do setor têxtil e de moda.
Experiência em marcas de moda lifestyle com alto nível de valor agregado e identidade autoral.
Capacidade de atuar como referência criativa e mentora para os designers do time.
Conhecimento em análise de performance estética para otimização de coleções futuras.

title: Encarregado de laboratório (solos, concreto e asfalto)

Coordenar e supervisionar a equipe de laboratório e campo;
Planejar, executar e validar ensaios de solos, concreto e asfalto;
Garantir o cumprimento das normas técnicas (ABNT / DNIT / DNER);
Acompanhar resultados, elaborar relatórios e apoiar a engenharia;
Zelar pela calibração, conservação dos equipamentos e organização do laboratório. Concreto: moldagem e rompimento de corpos de prova, slump test, teor de ar, compressão, tração na flexão, módulo de elasticidade.

Formação técnica ou superior em áreas correlatas;
Experiência em laboratório de solos, concreto e asfalto;
Vivência com liderança de equipes será diferencial;
Perfil organizado, analítico e comprometido com qualidade.

title: Especialista de modelagem hidráulica pleno
description:
A Aegea
Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.
A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças. Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

Conduzir autonomamente estudos hidráulicos para sistemas de abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário.
Elaborar e validar documentação técnica de estudos internos e de terceiros.
Desenvolver análises, cenários críticos e estudos de ampliação em sistemas de água e esgoto.
Executar e validar calibrações de modelos hidráulicos com base em dados monitorados.
Participar da análise de viabilidade econômica de soluções técnicas de infraestrutura.

Disponibilidade para viagens pontuais.

Reunir referências de tendências de moda esportiva e streetwear.

title: Especialista em design de calçados
description:
Especialista em Design de Calçados
Localização: Rio de Janeiro – RJ
I. A Missão da Posição
O Especialista de Design (Shoes) possui um perfil híbrido, sendo responsável por todo o ciclo do calçado: desde a concepção criativa e estética (estilista) até a tradução técnica e funcional do produto (designer)2. Sua missão é garantir o equilíbrio entre a identidade de moda athleisure e a viabilidade produtiva, atuando de forma estratégica para que cada modelo seja, simultaneamente, um objeto de desejo e uma solução técnica de alta performance. Ele atua como o elo central entre o conceito criativo e o produto acabado, servindo como referência técnica e estética para o time.
II. Responsabilidades Principais Criação e Tradução de Design: Propor conceitos criativos, temas e cartelas de cores, traduzindo-os em desenhos técnicos e especificações detalhadas para a construção de calçados. Pesquisa e Inovação em Materiais: Realizar pesquisas de tendências globais e comportamento do consumidor, focando na aplicação de materiais tecnológicos e tecidos sintéticos voltados para alta performance. Desenvolvimento e Refinamento Técnico: Atuar diretamente com Sourcing e Fornecedores no desenvolvimento de fôrmas, solados e componentes, garantindo que a proposta estética original seja mantida durante o processo de prototipagem e provas de calce. Interface Estratégica: Colaborar de forma integrada com as áreas de Produto, Comercial e Produção para assegurar que o design respeite a viabilidade técnica e as metas de margem do negócio. Guardião da Identidade e Ergonomia: Garantir a consistência visual das linhas de calçados, zelando pela qualidade estética e pela ergonomia, assegurando que o produto final reflita o DNA da marca.
Análise de Evolução de Produto: Monitorar a performance de vendas e o feedback de mercado para retroalimentar o processo criativo com melhorias contínuas no mix de produtos.
III. Requisitos e Qualificações Experiência Profissional: Experiência consolidada atuando no ciclo completo de calçados (estilo e design técnico) em marcas de moda, sportswear ou acessórios. Domínio Técnico-Criativo: Profundo conhecimento em processos de fabricação, materiais têxteis/sintéticos e habilidade técnica para leitura e criação de fichas e componentes. Vivência em Chão de Fábrica: Experiência prática no acompanhamento de produção e desenvolvimento junto a fornecedores. Habilidades Analíticas: Capacidade de traduzir o conceito da marca em produtos funcionais, equilibrando olhar apurado com as necessidades comerciais do mercado.
Formação: Graduação em Design de Produto, Moda, Design de Moda ou áreas correlatas.
IV. Diferenciais
Experiência específica no desenvolvimento de sneakers ou calçados utilitários para o nicho Athleisure.
Capacidade de transitar com agilidade entre a criação artística e o rigor técnico do design.
Vivência em ambientes de alta escala com múltiplas coleções e fluxos dinâmicos de lançamento.
Conhecimento em análise de dados de mercado voltados especificamente para o setor de calçados.

title: Senior staff reservoir simulation engineer
description:
Position Summary
CMG is seeking a Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer to join our Customer Success and Consulting team. This is a full-time, permanent position. As part of the growing costumer success and consulting team, the successful candidate will play an active role in delivering high quality consulting, support and training services to end users and customers of CMG in a global setting.
CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.
Essential Responsibilities
The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.
The successful candidate will:
Become very proficient with CMG’s software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.
Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.
Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.
Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues.
Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise.
Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction.
Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.
The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities.
Education
Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree.
Knowledge & Skills
This is a technical role that will require a good understanding of reservoir engineering concepts, enhanced recovery methods and reservoir simulation concepts.
Experience in advanced processes such as enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or emerging energy transition processes an asset.
Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues.
Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Self-motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi-task in a dynamic work environment.
Ability to clearly advise clients on technical matters.
Excellent public speaking and presentation skills.
Familiarity with state-of-the-art engineering software.
Hands-on experience with CMG simulation software or any other reservoir simulator an asset.
Require minimal supervision and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
Working proficiency of company standard MS Windows and associated office productivity software tools (Word, Excel, Power Point).
All applicants must be legally entitled to live and work in Brazil.
Be customer focused, learn about the business to help bring value to our customers.
Team focused with a positive attitude, must be self-motivated, and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
Experience Minimum of 15 years of experience is required.
No need to call us about the status of your application. We promise—we’re reviewing every submission, and if your skills are a match, you’ll hear from us!
We kindly request that external recruiters and agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles. Submissions without a signed agreement in place will not be considered and will become the property of CMG.

Innovators in Simulation Technology
CMG (TSX: CMG) is a global software and consulting company that combines science and technology with deep industry expertise to solve complex subsurface and surface challenges for the new energy industry around the world. title: Network engineer commissioning specialist (bsc/rnc), oss and sites
description:
We are looking for a Wireless Specialist with solid experience in mobile networks, responsible for commissioning, integration, and validation of Controllers (BSC/RNC), as well as operation and management of OSS platforms and support for field activities related to telecommunications sites.
This professional will work directly throughout the deployment, expansion, and optimization cycle of the network, ensuring performance, availability, and compliance with the client’s technical requirements.
Responsibilities: (Must-have). Perform commissioning, integration, testing, and troubleshooting of 2 G/3 G/4 G/5 G, Controllers (BSC/RNC) and OSS. Execute configuration, expansion, and technical audit activities on OSS platforms.
Support and accompany field activities related to the activation of new sites, swaps, migrations, and network expansions.
Ensure correct implementation of parameters, scripts, and integration routines.
Monitor network KPIs and alarms, identifying and proactively resolving faults.
Prepare technical reports, action plans, and network documentation.
Work collaboratively with planning, O& M, and optimization teams to ensure network performance and stability.
Provide technical support during maintenance windows and critical activation processes including SWAPs.
Technical Requirements:
Proven experience with BSC and/or RNC Controllers (any vendor: ZTE, Ericsson, Nokia, Huawei).
Knowledge of OSS and network management tools.
Strong understanding of commissioning, integration, and troubleshooting processes for 2 G/3 G/4 G/5 G networks.
Solid knowledge of RF, parameters, handovers, features, and network architecture.
Ability to interpret logs, KPIs, and performance reports.
Experience with integration scripts (MML, CLI, or equivalent).
Desirable experience with O& M interfaces and network databases.
Knowledge of field processes: Survey, Swap, and site activation.
Desired Profile:
Analytical, organized, and strong problem-solving skills.
Clear and objective communication with clients and internal teams.
Ability to work under pressure and during critical maintenance windows.
Proactive and collaborative attitude.
Education:
Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields.
Certifications or training related to mobile networks will be considered an advantage.

title: Quality analyst
description:
About us:
DTX Aerospace is a leading company in the aerospace industry. Known for its innovative approach and cutting-edge technology, the company specializes in the design, manufacture, and maintenance of Landing Gears. With a strong focus on quality and safety, we have established ourselves as a trusted partner to many major airlines and military organizations worldwide. We are committed to continuous improvement and sustainability, investing heavily in research and development to drive the industry forward.
About the job:
The Quality Analiyst will support the Quality Assurance team in our MRO facility, specializing in landing gear maintenance, repair, and overhaul. Reporting directly to the Quality Assurance Manager, the Quality Auditor is responsible for performing audits, inspections, and assessments to ensure compliance with aviation regulations, internal procedures, and customer requirements.
Audit & Compliance: Conduct scheduled and unscheduled internal audits in accordance with the Quality Management System (QMS) and regulatory standards (e.g., FAA, EASA, ANAC). Evaluate compliance of processes related to landing gear disassembly, inspection, repair, assembly, and testing.
Assist in preparing for and supporting external audits (regulatory and customer). Inspection Oversight:
Review work orders, inspection records, and traceability documentation for accuracy and completeness.
Observe and assess maintenance activities for conformity to procedures and applicable standards.
Verify proper implementation of corrective and preventive actions (CAPA). Non-Conformance Management: Identify and document non-conformances (NCRs) during audits or inspections. Assist in root cause analysis and follow-up on corrective action implementation.
Track and report audit findings and trends to the Quality Assurance Manager. Documentation & Records:
Maintain accurate records of audits, inspections, and findings.
Ensure all documentation complies with regulatory, customer, and company requirements.
Participate in the continuous improvement of procedures and forms used in the QA function. Training & Communication:
Support ongoing quality awareness and training initiatives within the facility.
Communicate findings professionally and constructively to relevant departments and personnel.
Control technical training and training documentation for regulatory agencies and documents
Promote a culture of safety, quality, and compliance.
Work Experience:
Minimum 3 years of experience in MRO, preferably with aviation.
Experience in auditing, inspection, or quality control in an FAA or EASA-regulated environment.
Educational:
High school diploma or GED required; associate or bachelor's degree in Aviation Maintenance, Quality, or Engineering is a plus.
Technical Skills:
Working knowledge of aviation quality standards and regulatory requirements.
Soft Skills:
Strong attention to detail and analytical skills.
Effective written and verbal communication.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and QMS-related software systems.
Ability to work independently and maintain objectivity in audits.
Full Time in Galeão - RJ.

title: Analista de validação de processo
description:
1. Planejar, coordenar e executar estudos de validação de processos de fabricação. Elaborar protocolos, relatórios e análises críticas para suportar a reprodutibilidade e consistência do processo.
2. Desenvolver e executar protocolos de validação de limpeza para assegurar a remoção eficaz de resíduos e evitar a contaminação cruzada. Determinar os limites de aceitação de acordo com os requisitos de boas práticas de fabricação (GMP).
3. Planejar e conduzir validações de filtração esterilizante, incluindo testes de integridade, adsorção e retenção bacteriana para garantir a eficácia dos filtros utilizados nos processos de esterilização.
4. Realizar estudos de tempo de espera (holding time) para determinar e validar os tempos máximos permitidos entre as etapas críticas de produção, garantindo a manutenção da qualidade e esterilidade dos produtos.
5. Elaborar, revisar e aprovar protocolos, relatórios de validação de envase asséptico e outros documentos técnicos. Garantir a integridade e a rastreabilidade de todos os registros, em conformidade com as exigências regulamentares e padrões internos.
6. Atuar como referência técnica em processos de validação durante auditorias internas e externas, incluindo inspeções de autoridades sanitárias e auditorias de clientes.
7. Participação ativa em investigações de desvios, propondo ações corretivas e preventivas;
8. Elaborar apresentações e treinamentos referentes às atividades sob sua responsabilidade.
9. Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes de qualidade, produção, engenharia e desenvolvimento, para a implementação de melhorias contínuas nos processos validados e o suporte técnico necessário em projetos e mudanças.
10. Participação da elaboração de URS (User Requirements Specification) para definição de novos projetos ou alteração de projetos já existentes.

title: Analista de reforma tributária sênior
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.
A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a br Malls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.
Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a br Malls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.
E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.
Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Realizar o mapeamento dos impactos da Reforma Tributária (CBS e IBS) sobre as atividades do grupo;
Elaborar análises, simulações, comparativos e relatórios;
Participar da definição e do preenchimento dos novos campos das notas fiscais de saídas, contabilização, apuração assistida, recolhimento e da configuração dos sistemas (ERP e satélites);
Participar da definição e do preenchimento das novas regras de creditamento sobre as notas fiscais de entrada;
Apoiar revisões fiscais de contratos;
Propor melhorias operacionais e apoiar a implantação de controles, automações e validações fiscais, assegurando o cumprimento das obrigações acessórias e a mitigação de riscos tributários;
Atuar com diferentes interfaces e áreas, orientando e promovendo alinhamento, atualizações e adequações de processos;
Atendimento à fiscalização e auditoria;
Acompanhar a legislação complementar e as regulamentações federais, estaduais e municipais relacionadas à Reforma Tributária.
Requisitos e qualificações
Formação superior em Direito ou Ciências Contábeis;
Domínio dos tributos indiretos (ICMS, ISS, PIS, COFINS) e conhecimento dos novos modelos (CBS, IBS);

title: Sales executive - shipyards & shipowners
description:
Job Title: Sales Executive – Shipyards & Shipowners
Department: Sales
Role Summary
The Sales Executive – Shipyards & Shipowners will play a key role in M& O Partners’ commercial growth by representing our suppliers’ products and services to shipyards and shipowners across the maritime and offshore sectors. Reporting directly to the Director of Sales – Marine & Offshore and working closely with the Sales Manager , this position focuses on identifying new business opportunities, strengthening client relationships, and supporting the successful introduction of supplier solutions to shipbuilding, conversion, and vessel maintenance projects.
The Sales Executive will engage directly with shipyards, vessel owners, and technical teams, delivering value-based proposals and ensuring M& O’s solutions are well-positioned to meet client needs and project requirements.
Key Responsibilities
Product & Solution Representation
Develop a deep understanding of the suppliers’ products and their applications within shipbuilding, repair, and conversion projects.
Provide technical and commercial presentations tailored to shipyards and shipowner requirements.
Maintain up-to-date knowledge of supplier technologies, certifications, and industry standards. Business Development
Identify and develop new business opportunities with shipyards, shipowners, and related stakeholders in the maritime and offshore markets.
Build and manage a pipeline of qualified prospects through proactive outreach, industry networking, and relationship building.
Convert leads into sales opportunities and manage the full sales process from initial contact to contract closure.
Expand M& O’s presence within key accounts, ensuring continuous engagement and satisfaction. Market Intelligence & Competitive Insight
Monitor market trends, shipbuilding projects, fleet expansions, and dry-docking activities across the region.
Analyze competitors’ positioning, pricing, and service offerings to identify differentiation opportunities.
Share market insights and customer feedback with internal teams and supplier partners to guide strategic decisions. Sales Strategy & Reporting
Support the development and execution of sales strategies aligned with M& O’s objectives in the marine and offshore sectors.
Maintain accurate records of opportunities, client interactions, and pipeline status within the CRM system.

description:
About the Company
Hello! Welcome to Plaza Premium Group, we're people passionate about " Making Travel Better". We are a global company with team members from all walks of life, together we are #PPGFamily, together we are building a legacy. You don't need to be from this industry, you do need to be passionate.

-We will respect and value your background and perspectives
-We will work together with integrity
-We will share our incredible pride for job, company, and industry
What we ask of you:
-Bring passion to all that you do
-Listen, move fast and think innovatively
-Speak up, have ideas, and share them
-Believe in customer service, and treating every person with kindness
As industry leaders in innovating global airport hospitality, you will work with colleagues from all parts of the world for a truly global experience. You will help and craft services and facilities in over 200 locations in more than 60 international airports across the world.
Who we are:
We were established in HK in 1998 by someone who understood the value of an airport lounge and felt that the experience shouldn't just be limited to a closed-circuit group of travellers. Through the years we have worked incredibly hard to create an experience that is both accessible and quality. Almost 26 years later we now span four core business segments: airport lounges, airport terminal hotels, airport meet & greet services, and a range of airport dining concepts. In addition to our own brands, PPG provides airport hospitality solutions to leading airlines, alliances, and corporates around the world. Here are a few names you might recognize: Cathay Pacific Airways, Singapore Airlines, Lufthansa, etc.
With the future of travel always insight, we created Smart Traveller, a mobile-app rewards program underpinned by in-house technology. We are fast-moving and always evolving to drive our purpose of making travel better.
Join our family today.
Together, we'll make travel better.
About the job:
The General Manager of Operations is accountable for overseeing the entire operational ecosystem for Plaza Premium within the Rio de Janeiro airport system. This leadership role ensures that all guest touchpoints deliver the highest standards of quality, efficiency, and hospitality, providing an exceptional experience for every traveller. The General Manager of Operations is responsible for operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and guest satisfaction across all services.
Operational Management:
Oversee daily operations across Plaza Premium Group portfolio. including partner lounges
Develop, implement, and continuously improve operational policies and procedures tailored to Plaza Premium Group within the Rio de Janeiro airport system, enhancing guest experience and operational efficiency.
Monitor and analyse performance metrics for all services, identifying opportunities for improvement and implementing corrective actions
Ensure full compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements and company policies, including, labour laws, health &safety, and airports standards.
Coordinate with other departments to guarantee integrated operations and outstanding guest satisfaction.
Own the customer experience and Net Promoter Score (NPS) across all customer touch points.
Financial Management:
Accountable for the P& L, budgeting, forecasting and cost control within the Rio de Janeiro airport system
Responsible for hiring, training and engagement.
Job Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in business, hospitality, real estate, or related field (MBA is plus)
Fluency in Portuguese and English (mandatory); Spanish is a plus. 10+ years of experience in senior management, experience in hotels, airport operations & hospitality is an advantage
Preference to have a track record in managing multi-service operations within airports or similar industries
Proven ability to build long-term partnerships with clients
Strong understanding of airport infrastructure and regulatory environments in Central & South America (is a plus)
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and financial acumen
Willingness to travel frequently within the region
Demonstrates exceptional interpersonal skills, emotional intelligence & empathy

Portfólio de casos de sucesso.

description:
Vaga Afirmativa Advogada Controller Jurídico.
O Escritório Vila Nova e Brandão advogados ( é um escritório de pequeno porte, moderno e em franco crescimento, contrata advogada preta, formada há no máximo três anos, com carteira da OAB para o cargo de Advogada controller jurídico em trabalho presencial. 
O cargo que estamos ofertando é para Advogada controller jurídico júnior, que é a profissional em início de carreira porém com experiência e autonomia para gerir os processos pelo qual será responsável, sempre supervisionada pelo advogado sênior do escritório. É uma função estratégica e de muita confiança.
A Advogada Controller Jurídico é a profissional responsável por garantir que os processos do escritório caminhem com organização, previsibilidade e segurança técnica. É ela quem acompanha diariamente os prazos, movimentações processuais e demandas extrajudiciais (cartórios, RGIs, Certidões, etc), assegurando que nenhuma providência passe despercebida, que as peças sejam produzidas em tempo oportuno e que as rotinas do escritório fluam com eficiência. Atua como ponto central entre os advogados, os sistemas eletrônicos, os cartórios e os clientes, organizando informações, prevenindo riscos, padronizando procedimentos e contribuindo ativamente para a qualidade e a estratégia do trabalho jurídico desenvolvido. Mais do que controlar prazos, a Controller é a guardiã da gestão dos processos e da excelência operacional do escritório.
O cargo requer profundo conhecimento e habilidade nos sistemas de processo eletrônico (DPC/TJRJ, PJE, E-Saj, E-Proc, etc), além de conhecimento nos sistemas extrajudiciais RI - Digital e Emissão de Certidões.
Para o preenchimento da vaga a profissional, além de ser formada em direito, tem que ser uma pessoa proativa, ter bom humor, brilho nos olhos, ter raciocínio lógico, saber usar os programas básicos do computador e ter disposição para aprender e operar os sistemas utilizados pelo escritório.

Qualificações Inscrição na Ordem dos Advogados do Brasil; proativa, excelente redação, e escrita fluida, desembaraçada, espírito de equipe e inovadora; ser muito organizada; ser muito responsável e comprometida; gostar de rotina; ser eloquente; estar aberta a aprender; Comunicativa e gostar de trabalhar em grupo. É desejável que tenha experiência prévia nas áreas de controladoria jurídica e advocacia extrajudicial cível, imobiliária e sucessória através de estágios e ou exercício da advocacia.
Requisitos para ocupação do cargo: 
1 - Ensino superior em Direito;
2 - Inscrição na OAB;
3 - Experiência de 2 anos, conhecimento básico em gestão de processos jurídicos;
4 - Controle de prazos - Desejável habilidade no sistema ASTREA; 
5 - Conhecimento e prática nos sistemas de processo eletrônico (DPC/TJRJ, PJE, E-Saj, E-Proc, etc), além ddos sistemas extrajudiciais RI - Digital e Emissão de Certidões
6 - Conhecimento técnico em procedimentos extrajudiciais (inventários, usucapião judicial e extrajudicial, adjudicação compulsória, compra e venda, testamentos, doações, procurações, etc;
7 - Habilidade em interagir com cartórios de notas, títulos e documentos, e cartórios registrais;
8 - Capacidade de identificar problemas nos processos e sugerir melhorias para aumentar a eficiência;
9 - Atuado no mínimo 1 ano de experiência no setor de controladoria jurídica;
10 - Facilidade no uso de inteligências artificiais (Gemini, Chatgpt, Notebook LM)

Será responsável por liderar e organizar as atividades das áreas Contábil e Fiscal, garantindo o cumprimento de metas, prazos e conformidade com normas e legislações. Atuar na orientação técnica a clientes internos, coordenar auditorias externas e fiscalizações, conduzir o fechamento contábil e assegurar o compliance fiscal das empresas do grupo.

REQUISITOS
Formação Superior Completa em Ciências Contábeis com CRC ativo.
Desejável Pós Graduação em Controladoria / Finanças / Gestão Tributária.
Inglês intermediário, desejável avançado.
5 anos de experiência profissional em empresas multinacionais e/ou nacionais.
Conhecimento de apuração de todos os tributos e entrega de obrigações acessórias munipais, estaduais e federais.
Experiência em planejamento tributário.
Experiência em revisão e elaboração de conciliação, análise de contas patrimoniais e resultado.
Experiência no preparo de demonstrações financeiras e caderno de auditoria, demonstrações financeiras base para publicação.
Conhecimento e aplicação das normas contábeis vigentes e revisão de demonstrações financeiras para a companhia de valores imobiliários.
Conhecimento e aplicação normas contábeis e IFRS.
Desejável conhecimento operacional módulo contábil: FI/CO - ERP SAP.
Desejável conhecimento em sistema fiscal (cockpit SAP).
Excel avançado.
Foco no cliente internos e apoio à boa gestão da empresa.
RESPONSABILIDADES:
Atender amplamente a auditoria externa, analisando as solicitações, esclarecendo contabilizações, controlando cronogramas e demandas, garantindo que as demonstrações reproduzam fielmente a situação fiscal, contábil e financeira.
Desenvolver equipes fiscal e contábil promovendo a sinergia das áreas, visando a ampliação do conhecimento dos colaboradores.
Aprovar conciliações de todas as contas contábeis mantendo as principais em dia evitando divergências com auditoria externa ou não cumprimento das normas contábeis e fiscais vigentes.
Distribuir e implementar plano de ação carta de controles internos de auditoria externa, para redução ou mitigação dos pontos no próximo período.
Revisar e garantir a entrega de todas as obrigações junto aos orgãos Ferderais, Estaduais e municipais.
Aprovar e acompanhar as rotinas de encerramento de exercício e melhorias em sistemas, avançando em melhores práticas de controles fiscais e contábeis.
Prestar orientação contábil e fiscal para os clientes internos relativo ao caderno de auditoria, operações, legislação vigente ou demais situações técnicas para a correta aplicação e não exposição da empresa.
Transmitir as informações a usuários e órgãos reguladores,.
Aprovar lançamentos provenientes de reorganização societária para atendimento a normas vigentes.
Elaborar comentário sobre desempenho e relatório da diretoria nas demonstrações Financeiras auditadas;
Assegurar a entrega no prazo e correta de todas as obrigações acessórias nas diversas esferas tributárias, garantindo o compliance fiscal.
Assegurar que as operações fiscais da organização estejam ocorrendo em conformidade com a legislação fiscal corrente evitando autuações, multas e sanções.
Analisar e buscar o aproveitamento dos créditos tributários obtidos pela empresa, por meio de compensações, restituições ou transferência para outras unidades, contribuindo para a melhora no caixa e resultado.
Orientar e transmitir à equipe fiscal as mudanças ocorridas na legislação fiscal, por meio de instruções e informativos, garantindo que todos os colaboradores estejam atualizados.
Decidir com segurança e clareza sobre questões dúbias ou polêmicas referente a tributação, por meio de análise criteriosa da legislação vigente, buscando evitar os riscos de passivo.
Contribuir no adequado fechamento contábil, validando saldos contábeis a pagar e a recuperar de tributos.
Identificar oportunidades de redução na carga fiscal, discutindo interna e externamente sobre possibilidades decorrentes do nosso negócio ou posicionamento dos fiscos e tribunais.
Assegurar que todos os registros fiscais sejam efetuados dentro do período de competência, através da de controles das atividades e dos relatórios de apuração extraídos do sistema.
Coordenar o atendimento aos processos de fiscalização, auditorias internas e externa ocorridos na empresa.

title: Design Director, Ui/Ux & Brand
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

We are hiring a Design Director - a visionary leader with a strong design background who thrives in driving high-quality design execution across various platforms as well as managing creative talent. You’ll combine strategic oversight with hands-on involvement, ensuring that every design project meets the highest standards of excellence.

This role requires deep experience in branded UI/UX design. You’re a senior-level design lead that can independently own multiple web design engagements simultaneously. Navigating client feedback and pushback is an everyday muscle you successfully work with. You can show deep experience in being able to thread the needle between game-changing UI, conversion-oriented UX, and technical feasibility, all on a tight timeline. Clients are consistently impressed by your knowledge of e-commerce heuristics and how you combine that with unique and branded design. You love working with developers to understand how to make your ideas come to life and sell clients on design solutions and tradeoffs they have to make to complete engagements on-time.

You pride yourself on being able to effortlessly spin up a new brand design system for a client that feels differentiated, elevated, and informed by your strategic market analysis. You have consistently merged business thinking with exceptional visual craft into scalable brand identities that work across paid media, retention, web, social, and packaging.

In addition to your individual contributor responsibilities, you will report to the Director of Creative and play a key role in guiding a talented team of designers, overseeing the delivery of exceptional designs for paid ads, emails, landing pages, and e-commerce web design. With your deep expertise in UI/UX and brand design, you’ll empower your team to elevate their skills while maintaining a high bar for creative output and attention to detail.

This role requires a balance of creativity, business strategy, and leadership in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. You’ll work closely with marketing, product, and development teams to ensure the alignment of design goals with broader business objectives. Your ability to drive creative strategy and manage multiple projects with precision will be essential to your success. Darkroom is a career incubator for ambitious talent looking to operate at the intersection of business, design, and innovation.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English. Open to candidates in the following locations: Brazil, Mexico, Portugal, and Spain.

Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities:

  • Lead 1-3 UI/UX engagements as needed, focusing on creating branded e-commerce websites.

  • Emphasize branded UI, conversion-focused UX, and clarity in design approaches.

  • Present design work to clients, explaining design choices based on effective reasoning and UX principles.

  • Manage design projects independently from discovery to hand-off, adhering to timelines and collaborating with developers to ensure feasibility.

  • Develop component systems and maintain design guidelines for consistency.

Management Responsibilities:

  • Manage a team of designers, starting with 2-4 direct reports and expanding as the team grows. Provide support in strategy, project management, design feedback, performance evaluation, and handling escalations.

  • Conduct weekly 1:1s with direct reports to assess client health, offer feedback, and oversee career development.

  • Ensure high-quality work output from direct reports, focusing on visual craft, UX expertise, and meeting deadlines.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including marketers, strategists, developers, and clients, to develop project plans, understand business objectives, and address client issues.

  • Refine internal processes for client work in coordination with the Director of Creative. Provide training and feedback to enhance the skills of the design team.

You Should Apply if this Sounds Like You:

  • 3-6+ years of senior-level web design experience with e-commerce companies, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience in responsive web design.

  • Digital portfolio showcasing web design and branding skills, including color theory, hierarchy, composition, and typography.

  • Self-motivated, proactive, and detail-oriented with a strong sense of ownership.

  • Experience collaborating with developers and documenting designs for development hand-off.

  • Comfortable with client-facing responsibilities in English, including leading discovery calls and resolving client feedback.

  • Capable of providing constructive internal feedback and guiding direct reports to improve their work.

  • Ability to tackle ambiguous problems, understand business challenges, design solutions, and execute them effectively.

  • Proficiency in Figma, including features like Auto Layout, Components, and Variants, is essential.

  • Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) is required.

  • Bonus: Familiarity with HTML/CSS or frameworks like Tailwind.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote , employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model , including weekly in-office appearances . Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Head Of Brand, Marketing And Promotion
description:
Job Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”), which for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Commercial & Marketing

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Position Overview

The Head of Brand & Marketing at FWWC27 LTDA, which is FIFA’s Brazilian subsidiary responsible for the delivery of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Brazil (TM), will be tasked to guide and implement brand and marketing plans, campaigns and activations in line with the marketing & communication strategy. This role is critical to the success of the first ever FIFA Women’s World Cup to be held in South America with a vision to unite the world through an unprecedented experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Key Responsibilities
  • Act as an extension to, and be part of the global MBBI (Marketing, Brand, Business Intelligence) team based in Zurich with dual reporting lines, for being a key representative to all Brand, Marketing and Promotion Tournament matters.
  • Responsible for all promotional aspects including any communications designed and required to support the commercial and marketing objectives of the tournament.
  • Be the main liaison for Host Country and Host City representatives, tournament executive leadership representing the MBBI team.
  • Lead the local, regional and national delivery of various marketing campaigns and initiatives related to, and beyond identified tournament milestones.
  • Lead a team of brand & marketing professionals on the ground, and ensure seamless cooperation, collaboration and integration with all relevant functional areas at FWWC27 LTDA and FIFA’s head office in Zurich, as well as any other functional areas such as legal, finance, etc.
  • Identify and communicate opportunities to create dedicated local, regional or national promotional activities that support the objectives of the tournament, the marketing strategy, or any relevant stakeholders such as commercial partners, media partners, host cities, and others.
  • Identify and drive commercial value through the marketing of the tournament’s brand assets and intellectual property, including but not limited to mascots, licensing & retail, the FIFA Fan Festival, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Trophy Tour, official music tracks/album/sonic identities, and other.
  • Contribute to, and drive implementation of ticketing & hospitality go-to-market strategy and activations plans.
  • Establish and maintain strong and impactful relationships with relevant partners, celebrities, influencers, key event organizers, agencies, etc.
  • Manage and maintain budget and liaise with the relevant colleagues in Zurich in all matters budget and spend.
  • Oversee the correct implementation and utilization of all in-market tournament brand asset implementations and applications including, but not limited to, event and stadium dressing, experiential marketing applications, retail branding, and any other use of the brand assets by FIFA’s internal and external stakeholders.
  • Manage procurement and legal processes (in compliance with FWWC27 LTDA policies and guidelines) as it relates to the tendering and contracting of local, regional or national suppliers, service providers, agencies, and other.
  • Manage and deliver all necessary reporting measures related to the tournament.
  • Drive and manage effective communications between the relevant functional areas and, in particular with the MBBI team in Zurich.
Your Profile
  • Bachelor’s degree or similar higher education in marketing, or a marketing related discipline.
  • Minimum 10 years’ experience in a relevant leadership position.
  • Proven experience delivering major brand & marketing plans.
  • Experience in the sports and/or entertainment industry is a major plus.
  • Experience working in a global or international environment.
  • Proven track record in managing a team in a matrix or similar structure.
  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills and the ability to manage up, down and sideways.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills.
  • Profound knowledge of Brazilian and South American markets and culture.
  • Ability to work to deadlines and stress resilient.
  • Financial and budget management.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
Additional Information
  • Seniority level: Mid-Senior level
  • Employment type: Contract
  • Job function: Marketing and Sales

title: Design Director, Ui/Ux & Brand
description:
Design Director, UI/UX & Brand

Join to apply for the Design Director, UI/UX & Brand role at Darkroom

About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About The Role

We are hiring a Design Director - a visionary leader with a strong design background who thrives in driving high-quality design execution across various platforms as well as managing creative talent. You’ll combine strategic oversight with hands‑on involvement, ensuring that every design project meets the highest standards of excellence.

This role requires deep experience in branded UI/UX design. You’re a senior‑level design lead that can independently own multiple web design engagements simultaneously. Navigating client feedback and pushback is an everyday muscle you successfully work with. You can show deep experience in being able to thread the needle between game‑changing UI, conversion‑oriented UX, and technical feasibility, all on a tight timeline. Clients are consistently impressed by your knowledge of e‑commerce heuristics and how you combine that with unique and branded design. You love working with developers to understand how to make your ideas come to life and sell clients on design solutions and tradeoffs they have to make to complete engagements on‑time.

You pride yourself on being able to effortlessly spin up a new brand design system for a client that feels differentiated, elevated, and informed by your strategic market analysis. You have consistently merged business thinking with exceptional visual craft into scalable brand identities that work across paid media, retention, web, social, and packaging.

In addition to your individual contributor responsibilities, you will report to the Director of Creative and play a key role in guiding a talented team of designers, overseeing the delivery of exceptional designs for paid ads, emails, landing pages, and e‑commerce web design. With your deep expertise in UI/UX and brand design, you’ll empower your team to elevate their skills while maintaining a high bar for creative output and attention to detail.

This role requires a balance of creativity, business strategy, and leadership in a fast‑paced, collaborative environment. You’ll work closely with marketing, product, and development teams to ensure the alignment of design goals with broader business objectives. Your ability to drive creative strategy and manage multiple projects with precision will be essential to your success. Darkroom is a career incubator for ambitious talent looking to operate at the intersection of business, design, and innovation.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English. Open to candidates in the following locations: Brazil, Mexico, Portugal, and Spain.

Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities
  • Lead 1-3 UI/UX engagements as needed, focusing on creating branded e-commerce websites.
  • Emphasize branded UI, conversion‑focused UX, and clarity in design approaches.
  • Present design work to clients, explaining design choices based on effective reasoning and UX principles.
  • Manage design projects independently from discovery to hand‑off, adhering to timelines and collaborating with developers to ensure feasibility.
  • Develop component systems and maintain design guidelines for consistency.
Management Responsibilities
  • Manage a team of designers, starting with 2-4 direct reports and expanding as the team grows. Provide support in strategy, project management, design feedback, performance evaluation, and handling escalations.
  • Conduct weekly 1:1s with direct reports to assess client health, offer feedback, and oversee career development.
  • Ensure high‑quality work output from direct reports, focusing on visual craft, UX expertise, and meeting deadlines.
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams, including marketers, strategists, developers, and clients, to develop project plans, understand business objectives, and address client issues.
  • Refine internal processes for client work in coordination with the Director of Creative. Provide training and feedback to enhance the skills of the design team.
You Should Apply if this Sounds Like You
  • 3-6+ years of senior‑level web design experience with e-commerce companies, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience in responsive web design.
  • Digital portfolio showcasing web design and branding skills, including color theory, hierarchy, composition, and typography.
  • Self‑motivated, proactive, and detail‑oriented with a strong sense of ownership.
  • Experience collaborating with developers and documenting designs for development hand‑off.
  • Comfortable with client‑facing responsibilities in English, including leading discovery calls and resolving client feedback.
  • Capable of providing constructive internal feedback and guiding direct reports to improve their work.
  • Ability to tackle ambiguous problems, understand business challenges, design solutions, and execute them effectively.
  • Proficiency in Figma, including features like Auto Layout, Components, and Variants, is essential.
  • Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) is required.
  • Bonus: Familiarity with HTML/CSS or frameworks like Tailwind.
Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote, employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model, including weekly in‑office appearances. Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.
  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.
  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.
Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. employees are expected to be professional, punctual, maintain regular attendance, cooperative, organized, and enthusiastic.

  • Secure and evaluate a patient''s health history and record findings in a systematic, accurate, and succinct manner.

    participate in care coordination and policy development as required.

    work within privileges and protocols established by the CMO.
  • Participate in committees as requested;
    adhere to safety and infection control policies;
    provide age-appropriatecare across patient populations.

    participate in patient population management with cultural sensitivity and appropriate local resources.

    contribute to quality improvement using evidence-based practices.

May supervise mid-level providers at the direction of the Chief Medical Officer.

  • Education: Medical Doctor (M.D.) or Doctor of Osteopathy (D.O.) from an accredited medical school.

    Spanish bilingual desirable.

As listed under Qualifications above.

Abbott é líder global em saúde, desenvolvendo uma ciência inovadora para melhorar a saúde das pessoas. Estamos sempre olhando para o futuro, antecipando mudanças na ciência e em tecnologias médicas.

Trabalhando na Abbott
Na Abbott, você pode realizar um trabalho importante, crescer e aprender, cuidar de si mesmo e de sua família, ser você mesmo e viver de maneira plena. Você terá acesso a:

  • Desenvolvimento de carreira em uma empresa internacional onde é possível crescer na carreira dos seus sonhos

Coordenar as atividades de Pré-Formulação, garantindo o desenvolvimento de formulações e processos seguros, robustos e com seus parâmetros críticos identificados. Realizar e avaliar todas as análises de pré-formulação que suportam o processo de desenvolvimento de produtos.

ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Coordenar a equipe de Pré-Formulação e o conteúdo técnico científico elaborado;
    através de um processo racional e padronizado de desenvolvimento, baseado em ciência e investigação, visando sempre a qualidade no processo de desenvolvimento;
  • Promover o desenvolvimento de novos produtos, formulações e processos de fabricação garantindo o aumento do portfólio da empresa em acordo com o plano comercial da Abbott;
  • Ter conhecimento robusto e aprofundado sobre os princípios de Pré-formulação, tais como a utilização de todos os equipamentos relacionados, pesquisas bibliográficas e elaboração de relatórios técnicos que suportem a criação de racional técnico para o desenvolvimento de produtos;
  • Promover as iniciativas de QbD/DoE no contexto de desenvolvimento de produtos;
  • Coordenar pessoas, contribuindo de forma efetiva para o desenvolvimento interpessoal, aumento de performance, detecção de habilidades e pontos de melhoria para criação de uma equipe de alta performance;
  • Coordenar fluxos e processos, mantendo os custos e escopo dos projetos em linha com o cronograma e detectando possíveis falhas e riscos para identificar oportunidades de melhoria e evitar atrasos.
  • Responsável pelas interações com os serviços terceirizados relacionados;
  • Avaliar e elaborar viabilidade para novos projetos, mapeando e identificando as oportunidades, bem como dar suporte para os times de galênico, analítico e suprimentos no centro de desenvolvimento.
  • Responsável pelos estudos de deformulação/engenharia reversa que orientem o desenvolvimento de produtos.
  • Participar da revisão dossiê técnico na parte de pré-formulação para submissão na ANVISA ou outras agências reguladoras regionais e globais.
  • Responsável por pesquisar, avaliar e apresentar novas oportunidades de tecnologias para a área de pré-formulação.
  • Responsável por todas as atividades relacionadas à pré-formulação conforme descrito em PO atualizados.
  • Garantir a padronização das atividades relacionadas ao setor, através da elaboração e/ou revisão dos Procedimentos Operacionais (PO).
  • Garantir para que a área de pré-formulação esteja sempre de acordo com as normas de GMP e EHS.
  • Conduzir as ações e decisões sob responsabilidade do cargo respeitando o Código de Conduta Comercial da empresa.
  • Estar atualizado com a legislação vigente para desenvolvimento de novos produtos e relacionadas.

ESCOLARIDADE

  • Superior completo em Farmácia, Engenharia Química ou Química.
  • Mestrado ou doutorado na área de caracterização de materiais ou afins que contemplem técnicas relacionadas à pré-formulação.

CONHECIMENTOS

  • Qualidade, GMP, Legislação de Medicamentos e pacote office.
  • Conhecimentos aprofundados sobre DSC, TGA, Infravermelho, Raman, difração de raio-X, e analisadores de partículas por difração a laser.
  • Desejável conhecimento em sistema SAP ou sistema similar e Segurança do Trabalho.
  • Inglês avançado.

EXPERIÊNCIA

Acima de 6 anos de experiência em Desenvolvimento de Produtos, especificamente na área de Pré-formulação.
